name: It's a me!
author: Eggscantfly
description: It's him. The one and only. Press M and the rabbids hand the level over: Mario hops in with a flip where the cart was, the camera swings in behind him, and he moves exactly the way he does in his own game - libsm64 runs his jumping, his collision and his animation, mouse and all. His punch lands like a boosting cart, so humans are stunned and drop what they carry, and the jump panels throw him just as far as they throw the rabbids, flipping all the way. He walks wherever the cart drives: the fences it passes through are nothing to him either. Press M again and the rabbids get their level back, no questions asked. He comes along everywhere, though he can only stand where the level has ground for him (Peach's castle brings its own). Press T while he has the level and a menu of his own game's enemies, bosses and items opens: Goombas, Koopas, Bob-ombs, Boos, Chain Chomps, Thwomps, King Bob-omb, Whomp King, Wiggler, Eyerok, Bowser and the rest, each running its own behaviour from SM64's code, each with a home of its own where it is spawned, right in front of him. SM64's HUD is drawn from your own Super Mario 64 (USA) .z64 while he plays - drop the ROM into this mod's folder, or name it in the mod's own config.ini. Nothing of Mario lives in wiimote.ini: the mod carries what it needs. Coins he picks up and stars he catches count on his HUD; a star is danced for with its jingle, and the level is his again after. Anyone who would say something says the one thing worth saying. And the level's own people fear what he lets loose: humans (and the Verminators) run from the nearest enemy the way they run from the cart.
